title: Heliski Canada
subtitle: 18-week indoor plan · 30 min Mon–Fri
description: 8–10 runs a day for 7 days is won or lost on day 4+. The plan builds eccentric quad endurance, single-leg strength and an engine, then tapers so you arrive fresh.
notes: Every session fits in 30 minutes including warm-up and finish. Weekends free.
After a 5-day hotel week, make the next home week's Mon/Wed heavy-backpack days and Tue longer; do not try to make up volume inside the hotel week.
Backpack: on the back for split squats, step-ups, step-downs, calf raises, lunges; on the thighs for wall sits; across the hips for bridges; never on jumps, hops or sprints.
Sunday check (60 s): 5 sessions done? Backpack kg, wall-sit seconds or circuit rounds higher than 3 weeks ago? Two flat weeks in a row means the plan changes.
Same session, same load, RPE dropping over 3 weeks: add load. RPE rising at the same load: you are under-recovered, no extra load.
RPE 1–10: 3–4 easy, could chat · 6–7 hard, 2–3 reps left · 8 very hard, 1 rep left · 9–10 failure (not in this plan).

backpack.name: Backpack 8–15 kg
backpack.description: Filled with water bottles or books.

chair.name: Sturdy chair
chair.description: Test it first. Bed edge works for split squats.

stairs.name: Stairwell / bench
stairs.description: 2 stairs or a bench for step-ups and step-downs.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.focus: Movement quality, controlled tempo, 2 reps short of failure.
phases.notes: Bodyweight or 8 kg. 60 s rest. Wall sit 45 s. Circuit 3 rounds.

phases.name: Strength-endurance
phases.focus: Density up: same 4 rounds, rest cut to 30 s, 3 s eccentrics everywhere.
phases.notes: Pack 10–12 kg. Wall sit 60 s in week 5, +15 s per week, max 2 min. Circuit 4 rounds. Pistol progression.

phases.name: Power + fatigue resistance
phases.focus: Plyometrics, working while already tired. Wed–Thu–Fri deliberately back-to-back.
phases.notes: Pack 15 kg on strength moves only. Jump lunges, hops, tuck jumps. Wall sit 3 min or single-leg. Circuit 4 rounds, 30 s rest. Strongly recommended: 3–4 resort ski days in December.

phases.name: Taper
phases.focus: Arrive fresh, not "one more workout" tired.
phases.notes: 3 rounds or fewer, same intensity, nothing new. Last hard session about 5 days before the first flight.

leg-swings.name: Leg swings
leg-swings.instructions: Front-to-back, hold a wall or chair for balance.

air-squat.name: Air squats
air-squat.instructions: Slow and controlled, full depth, heels down.

single-leg-balance.name: Single-leg balance
single-leg-balance.instructions: Stand on one leg, soft knee, hips level.

easy-movement.name: Easy in-room movement
easy-movement.instructions: Marching, step-jacks, slow chair step-ups. RPE 3–4, you can talk the whole time.

bulgarian-split-squat.name: Bulgarian split squat
bulgarian-split-squat.instructions: Rear foot on chair/bed. 3 s down, 1 s up. Front knee over the foot, torso upright. Home: backpack on the back.

media.alt: Bulgarian split squat (figure from the PDF)

step-up.name: Step-up
step-up.instructions: Onto a chair (hotel) or 2 stairs/bench (home). Drive through the TOP leg, no push-off from the floor. Lower slowly.

single-leg-glute-bridge.name: Single-leg glute bridge
single-leg-glute-bridge.instructions: Heels close to the glutes, lower back flat, push through the heel. 1 s squeeze at the top, hips level. Never with the pack on the back; home from phase 2 across the hips.

media.alt: Single-leg glute bridge (figure from the PDF)

calf-raise.name: Calf raise on an edge
calf-raise.instructions: Forefoot on a step, thick book or bathroom step edge. 2 s down to a full stretch, 1 s hold at the top. Pressure through the big-toe ball. No edge: flat floor, 2 s pause at the top.

media.alt: Calf raise on an edge (figure from the PDF)

single-leg-calf-raise.name: Single-leg calf raise
single-leg-calf-raise.instructions: Like the calf raise on an edge, on one leg. 2 s down to a full stretch, 1 s hold at the top.

media.alt: Single-leg calf raise (figure from the PDF)

pistol-progression.name: Pistol-squat progression
pistol-progression.instructions: Hold a door frame, lower on one leg as deep as you can control, other leg straight forward. Never with the pack.
cues: Only as deep as you control

jump-lunge.name: Jump lunges
jump-lunge.instructions: Switch legs in the air, land in a lunge. Land quietly. Never with the pack.

single-leg-hop.name: Single-leg hops
single-leg-hop.instructions: Small and quiet. Never with the pack.

rowerg.name: RowErg
rowerg.instructions: Legs first, then lean, then arms. Drive through the heels. Hard = you could not talk. Easy = full recovery pace.

stairwell.name: Stairwell: up easy, down slow
stairwell.instructions: Walk up easy. Walk down slowly on bent knees, 3 s per step, weight controlled by the standing leg. Do NOT jog down; the descent is the point.

media.alt: Stairwell: up easy, down slow (figure from the PDF)

fast-chair-step-up.name: Fast chair step-ups
fast-chair-step-up.instructions: Alternate legs, fast, full stand at the top. Burpees instead if the chair is shaky. Test the chair first.

media.alt: Fast chair step-ups (figure from the PDF)

chair-step-down.name: Slow chair step-downs
chair-step-down.instructions: Stand on the chair on one leg, lower the free heel to the floor over 3 s, tap, back up. This replaces the stairwell descent; do not rush it.

media.alt: Slow chair step-downs (figure from the PDF)

step-down.name: Step-down
step-down.instructions: Stand on the step on one leg, lower the free heel to the floor over 3 s, tap, drive back up. Knee tracks over the foot, hips level.

wall-sit.name: Wall sit
wall-sit.instructions: Thighs parallel, knees over ankles, weight in the heels, back and head on the wall. The set ends when thighs rise above parallel; log that time. Pack on the thighs, not the back.
cues: Back and head on the wall

single-leg-wall-sit.name: Single-leg wall sit
single-leg-wall-sit.instructions: Wall sit position, extend one leg straight. 30–45 s per side. Closer to skiing than a loaded two-leg sit.

media.alt: Single-leg wall sit (figure from the PDF)

eccentric-single-leg-squat.name: Eccentric single-leg squat to chair
eccentric-single-leg-squat.instructions: Lower on one leg over 3 s until seated, stand up on two legs. Arms forward for balance.

media.alt: Eccentric single-leg squat to chair (figure from the PDF)

tuck-jump.name: Tuck jumps
tuck-jump.instructions: Knees to chest, land soft and quiet. Loud landings mean stop. Never with the pack.

skater-hop.name: Skater hops
skater-hop.instructions: Push off sideways, land on one leg, hold 1 s, knee over toes, no wobble.

lateral-lunge.name: Lateral lunge
lateral-lunge.instructions: Big step to the side, sit back into that hip, other leg straight. Chest up.

side-plank.name: Side plank
side-plank.instructions: Straight line ear–hip–ankle, hips high, top arm to the ceiling.

copenhagen-plank.name: Copenhagen plank
copenhagen-plank.instructions: Side plank with the top foot on a chair or bed, bottom leg bent. Squeeze the inner thigh.

jump-squat.name: Jump squats
jump-squat.instructions: Sit back, explode up, land soft and silent into a quarter squat. Loud landing means you're done.

lateral-hop.name: Lateral hops
lateral-hop.instructions: Hop side to side over a line or towel, both feet, fast and quiet, knees soft.

reverse-lunge.name: Reverse lunges
reverse-lunge.instructions: Step back, rear knee to just above the floor, front knee over the foot. Alternate legs.

mountain-climber.name: Mountain climbers
mountain-climber.instructions: Plank, drive knees to chest fast, hips low.

stair-sprint.name: Stair sprint
stair-sprint.instructions: Sprint up the stairwell, walk down. Never with the pack.

hollow-hold.name: Hollow hold
hollow-hold.instructions: Lower back pressed into the floor, shoulders and legs lifted, arms overhead. If the back arches, raise the legs.

plank.name: Plank
plank.instructions: Forearms, straight line ear–hip–ankle, glutes squeezed, no sagging hips.

dead-bug.name: Dead bug
dead-bug.instructions: Lower back pressed flat. Opposite arm and leg lower slowly (2–3 s), exhale on the way out. If the back lifts, shorten the range.

deep-squat-hold.name: Deep squat hold
deep-squat-hold.instructions: Heels down, hips loose, knees pushed out with the elbows. Full ankle bend matters more than any stretch.

media.alt: Deep squat hold (figure from the PDF)

calf-stretch.name: Calf stretch
calf-stretch.instructions: Hands on the wall, back leg straight, heel down.

days.title: Conditioning
days.subtitle: Engine + controlled descents
days.why: 8–10 runs a day needs an aerobic engine; slow, controlled lowering is the closest bodyweight thing to the eccentric load of a long powder run.

items.note: Alternating legs. Burpees if the chair is shaky.
Alternating legs. Burpees if the chair is shaky.

items.note: Switch legs at the top with a small hop.

days.title: Eccentric + isometric
days.subtitle: The heli-week muscles
days.why: Eccentric quad load and long isometric holds are what fail on day 4+ of a heli week. This is the most important session of the week.

days.title: Lateral stability + easy cardio
days.subtitle: Recovery day
days.why: Deep snow loads the knee sideways on every turn. Stability protects it. The cardio is EASY on purpose: this day exists so Wednesday and Friday don't break you.

days.title: Ski circuit
days.subtitle: Simulate a long run
days.why: No rest between exercises simulates a 10-minute powder run: legs burning, still skiing clean. Landing quality is the whole point of the jumps.
